[![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://git.code.sf.net/p/grandperspectiv/source) [![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://sourceforge.net/projects/grandperspectiv/files/grandperspective/) [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/grandperspective/id1111570163?platform=mac)

summary.name: GrandPerspective
summary.one_liner: GrandPerspective is a small open-source macOS utility that shows disk usage as a tree map, with each file drawn as a rectangle sized by its file size.
keywords: what is taking up space on my mac
use_cases: Finding which files and folders take up the most space on a Mac
Cleaning up a disk by spotting large files to delete
Analysing Time Machine backup disk usage
Reviewing cloud storage usage on a Mac
Comparing disk usage before and after clean-up
summary.what_it_does: The app scans a file system and draws a tree map in which each file is a rectangle with area proportional to its size, with files in the same folder placed together. Views can be coloured by name, extension, file type, folder, size, or time attributes, and can be navigated with mouse or keyboard. Users can open, reveal, Quick Look, search, filter, or delete items from the view, and exclude folders when scanning. Scan results can be saved, reloaded, and exported as image or text.
notable: Open source under the GNU General Public License, free download from SourceForge
Also on the Mac App Store for $2.99 with the same app
Tree map views with configurable colour mapping and advanced filters
Localized into about a dozen languages
caveats: Latest release (3.8.1) requires macOS 14 or higher; older macOS versions need older releases
Palette selection is broken in the current release; only one built-in palette is available
App Store version costs $2.99 and lags SourceForge releases by a few weeks
